visual_nodes.graph_summary: Table 12 — Test accuracy (%) on Visual7W comparing different random decoy strategies to the proposed methods. The table shows that random decoy strategies (A) and (B) yield significantly lower performance (10.0%) than the proposed All method (45.1%), which combines Orig, IoU, and QoU decoys. The All method outperforms all random strategies and also shows a larger performance gap between MLP-IQA and other models compared to random decoys, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed decoy generation methods.
